findings.text: non-blocking: the evaluate closure rebuilds the field and supplies bank_rows, bank_moments and bank_exterior itself rather than reaching the change through nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:283, so dropping those three keywords from the production wiring - the step that makes the repair reach the saddle at all - leaves the test and the whole paired suite green, and the node's headline accuracy gain has no guard on the path that delivers it.

non-blocking: curvature_coefficients composes the bank contraction from wrap, multiply and the new _paired_sum instead of extending nova/biot/pairedfloat.py:106 contract and :114 contract_paired, which own that capability for the same operands and which support_read.py:160 nodal_jets already spells as exterior plus one einsum, so a second contraction idiom now exists for one quantity.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from f3bb6ed265 to 0445d78133 — a2416c572 reproduces the input-rounding attribution, 1af4c1b03 is the product fix in fixed_points/support_read/topology plus tests/test_saddle_derivatives.py, 47f6825c9 and 0775ade add receipt validation to the prototype report, 0445d7813 adds the evidence and figure; git diff --stat between the measured product head 1af4c1b03 and 0445d78133 is empty for nova/ and tests/, so the measured source is the landed source.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's three clauses are a reference test at the diverted 550-cell trial and converged saddles with a red negative control, a sixteen-lane floor at most 1e-11 per lane on the H200, and the locked precision budget with paired suites adding no failure; each is recorded in floor-base.log, floor-head.log, cpu-certificate-test_saddle_derivatives.log, cpu-negative-test_saddle_derivatives.log and the base/head suite logs, and each asserts its own number rather than restating the worker's prose.
item_verdicts.goal: the brief's goal is to compute the saddle's third and fourth derivatives from a source that does not amplify nodal rounding by h^-k; nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:141 curvature_coefficients carries the bank rows, moments and exterior in paired arithmetic through the selected triangle's Taylor residual and Bell transform, and nova/equilibrium/topology.py:3119 takes that branch whenever bank_rows is set, so the h^-4 amplification of rounded nodal flux is removed rather than re-derived.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, five commits, baseline 55 passed and head 57 passed with zero added failure ids, the 550-cell certificate arm at 2 passed, the restored-Bell negative control at EXIT=1 with maximum fourth-derivative discrepancy 1.2570500196318335e-12, and a landing line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are nova/equilibrium/support_read.py, nova/equilibrium/topology.py, nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py, tests/test_saddle_derivatives.py, scripts/prototypes/bank_saddle_derivatives, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-saddle-derivatives.html and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-saddle-derivatives; all twelve files in the diffstat lie inside that set.

justifications.durability: tests/test_saddle_derivatives.py:132 does redden on the restored-Bell regression (6.432e-14 and 1.257e-12 against a 2e-13 tolerance), but its evaluate closure at tests/test_saddle_derivatives.py:113 passes the bank keywords itself, so the support_read.py:283 wiring the fix depends on is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: I recomputed every per-lane median from floor-base/gpu.json and floor-head/gpu.json and they match the fragment's table exactly (head maximum 4.8245852e-12 against the 1e-11 bound), though the certificate log header at cpu-certificate-test_saddle_derivatives.log:1 omits the NOVA_SADDLE_CERTIFICATE export that suite.sh:49 sets.
justifications.fit: the new definitions follow the surrounding Bell-owner style in nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:296 and ruff passes on the touched files with the repository configuration; the function-local import at nova/equilibrium/topology.py:3115 is required by the fixed_points/topology import cycle.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:141 runs the contraction and the polynomial in paired arithmetic while nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:283 leaves the low-order jets and stationary solve on their previous path, which is what the goal asks and no more.
justifications.reuse: nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:152 re-expresses the contraction that nova/biot/pairedfloat.py:106 contract and :114 contract_paired already own instead of extending that owner, though every arithmetic step it performs does come from the pairedfloat helpers.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diffstat is inside the declared set and the four post-measurement commits touch only the evidence fragment, the figure and scripts/prototypes/bank_saddle_derivatives.
